screens.title: Set it up in one page
screens.caption: Store links or uploaded installers per platform, branding, page design, a copyable link with test buttons, and a QR code.

screens.title: The right button for every device
screens.caption: Phones go straight to their store. Anyone else gets a clean chooser page inside your own theme.

screens.title: Four page designs
screens.caption: Minimal, Hero, Split and Tiles. Each picks up your theme colour, or set your own accent.
